items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: I was used to hearing scat singing from the older days, Cab Calloway

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I’d like to show you something, yeah. This is fun because you know I learned something too from Neal Hefti. He was rehearsing the band one time, and we’d get to

Letter H or something, and he stopped the band and he said, “Look, brass, take it this way” [scats]. And I was used to hearing scat singing from the older days, Cab Calloway, some of Louis Armstrong’s things, Danny Kaye [scats]. You know? So when I heard Neal do that, I said he’s sounding like an instrument. So I started studying that — trombone a little, or alto, whatever. And it’s [scats]. Well you’ve got it there, so you want to go [scats]. Make it sound like it’s an instrument playing and you’re really…
